verdict.rationale: Publishing independent security audits is a fair question for an authenticator app with cloud sync, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any published third-party audit of the app or its sync protocol. The docs only describe the sync feature itself, and the GitHub items cover the HOTP/TOTP implementations, not audits.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
